description.text: A concept pack of the XY BREAK series released on 29 January 2016, named for the PokéKyun heart flutter that its cute, sparkling or cool illustrations are meant to cause. Every card is holo, four to a pack. Pikachu, Flareon-EX and Sylveon-EX drawn with other Eevee evolutions, Gardevoir-EX and M Gardevoir-EX, and Wally are among its cards. Japanese Wikipedia notes that it was popular with collectors who did not play. The cards are numbered to 32.
